thread:
SRE Bot: Incident: p99 decode tail spike detected in hosted-usw2 for streaming endpoints. p95 jumped from ~100ms to ~430ms; p99 up to 1.9s. Errors stable.

Taylor S: taking pager. seeing streaming stalls and token stalls. collecting traces.

A.J.: grafana link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/streaming/latency?panel=tail
Notice spike at 03:09 UTC; kernel pagefault counters rise at same time.

Kai Chen: Recent changes: kernel image roll to gpu-kp-2026-03-15 with compileflag -fkv-inline; and a TRT/FlashAttn runtime canary pushed to hosted canary at ~03:12 UTC. Both touch decode path.

Maria H: affected pools?

Taylor S: hosted pool only, model-quant-xl mainly. Dedicated pools unaffected.

A.J.: snippet from dmesg on affected node:
```
[  456.789012] decode_kv: page fault at 0x7fffab12
[  456.789014] kernel: stall 1820ms
[  456.789020] trace: decode_kv+0x210
```

Dena P: @A.J. map pods to node kernel tags please.

A.J.: nodes gpu-3-01..gpu-3-06 -> kp-2026-03-15-inline; gpu-3-07..gpu-3-16 -> kp-2026-03-13-stable. so mixed.

Kai Chen: -fkv-inline removed bounds checks for KV hotpath to speed up cold runs but might cause VM walk degeneracy under high churn -> pagefaults.

SRE Bot: Escalating to Sev2; notifying customers.

Taylor S: mitigation plan rank: 1) router fallback quant->fp16-hosted 2) runtime env toggle KV_SAFE=on to disable inline path 3) drain reprovision nodes to stable kernel 4) rollback TRT canary 5) kernel rollback.

Maria H: do routing + runtime toggle first.

A.J.: opsctl run:
```
opsctl router set-fallback --region=us-west-2 --from=model-quant-xl --to=model-fp16-xl --ttl=20m
```

ops-bot: router change accepted; progressive rollout started.

Taylor S: ~50% cutover in 40s: p95 -> ~200ms; p99 -> ~650ms. residual tails remain.

Kai Chen: runtime toggle name is KV_SAFE=1, we can set on model-serving-quant deployment.

A.J.: rolling env set:
```
kubectl set env deploy/model-serving-quant KV_SAFE=1 -n hosted-usw2
```
Rolling 8 pods at a time.

ops-bot: env change queued: ~96 pods.

Taylor S: first updated pods show p99 ~320-360ms. good.

Maria H: customer status blurb: "We are investigating increased tail latency for streaming in us-west-2. We applied routing fallback and a runtime safety toggle; working on node reprovision. Expected reduction in <30m."

Dena P: approved; posting now and looped in account teams for impacted customers (alpha-commerce, gamma-bot).

(15m)

A.J.: started drain/reprovision of gpu-3-01..gpu-3-04 back to kp-2026-03-13-stable. pods draining now.

Taylor S: draining+env toggle completed. p95 ~150ms, p99 ~190-240ms. streaming stalls resolved.

Kai Chen: TRT rollback not needed for now; will hold. Create RW-ING-1701 to run regression for -fkv-inline across streaming seq lengths and add pagefault fuzzing.

Dena P: created ticket RW-ING-1701, owner Kai Chen. Also adding runbook play for KV_SAFE and router fallback.

SRE Bot: incident status -> Mitigated. Severity lowered to Sev3. Monitoring.

Maria H: postmortem scheduled 2026-03-17 16:00 UTC; invites to eng-runtime, eng-sre, product.

Taylor S: handoff to Maria H in 30m. note: if p99 > 800ms re-open page and revert TRT canary.

A.J.: attaching logs, kernel backtraces, and opsctl commands to RW-ING-1701.

Kai Chen: will prepare a controlled A/B of -fkv-inline with better telemetry (pagefault counters, VM walk histograms) before next rollout.

Dena P: closing thread after postmortem ticket and status update.

(end of thread)
